content:
anna.dev: FYI saw a weird quota hit pattern this morning — lots of per-key bursts showing large completion token charges even when clients retried rapidly

mike.platform: any requests/ids?

anna.dev: digging, but here's a snippet from quota-enforcer logs where the billing scalar looks off
```
2025-11-02T09:10:12Z req=abc123 org=org-42 key=key-007 prompt_tokens=95 completion_tokens=0 tool_calls=1 retry_count=1 reserved_tokens=95 charged_tokens=190
2025-11-02T09:10:13Z req=abc123 org=org-42 key=key-007 prompt_tokens=95 completion_tokens=140 tool_calls=0 retry_count=2 reserved_tokens=95 charged_tokens=330
```

kevin-telemetry: hmm charged_tokens jumps mid-retry. Looks like we charged prompt twice and then completion on final success without de-duping the reservation?

jess-prodeng: are tool calls being double-accounted as completions? note first line has tool_calls=1 but completion_tokens=0 and still charged_tokens already doubled

anna.dev: exactly. My hypothesis: reserve logic sets reserved_tokens = prompt_tokens on initial attempt, but when a retry occurs we re-reserve additional prompt tokens because idempotency dedupe failed. Also toolcall -> forked request path sometimes converts reserved prompt into charged completion incorrectly.

mike.platform: do we have idempotency keys present from clients? or are our retry-layer generating new requests without the same idempotency header?

anna.dev: clients are sending idempotency in most cases, but internal requeues (burst requeueer) strip headers in some codepaths when routing to lower-priority pools.

kevin-telemetry: logged a few examples where request moved from primary->burst pool and lost header: `X-Idempotency` cleared by routing proxy: `if (route.burst) { proxy.clearHeaders(); }` sigh

jess-prodeng: oh no. So quota-enforcer sees a new key and reserves again. Then when final success returns, completion_tokens are charged on top of both reservations -> double charge.

sre-bot: incident note created: INC-20251102-01. temporary mitigation: disable header clearing in burst path and revert routing change from last deploy.

ops-bot: deploy-bot queued rollback candidate: rollback 2025-11-01 18:05:22 GMT (sha abcde)

mike.platform: long term we should change charge flow: reserve prompt tokens at request admission, mark reservation with idempotency_key, and when eventual completion arrives, only charge difference completion_tokens and clear reservation. Retries with same idempotency should not reserve again. Also tool calls should be accounted as prompt-side or completion-side consistently (pick one).

anna.dev: proposal: 3 changes
1) enforce idempotency ownership in proxy/routing (no header stripping)
2) make reservation record atomic with idempotency_key and route_id so requeues find it
3) shift toolcall accounting to be prompt_tokens (they originate from client prompt) and only charge completion_tokens for generated text

kevin-telemetry: will add metrics: `quota.reserve.count` tagged by idempotency_present:boolean, `quota.charge.delta` showing charged - reserved at finalization, and `quota.duplicate-reserve` counter for when we seen multiple reservations for same id

jess-prodeng: small patch idea: if reservation exists for idempotency_key, ignore additional reserves and attach new routing metadata to same reservation (so burst->primary handoff keeps single reservation). Can do quickfix today.

mike.platform: agree. Also add a short guard in billing pipeline: if charge would exceed reserved*3 (sane upper bound) mark audit flag instead of immediate debit, to avoid catastrophic double-charges while we roll fix.

anna.dev: putting a PR up for header-preserve rollback now. will also open a tracking ticket for the reservation dedupe work.

kevin-telemetry: tagging me in the ticket for dashboards. I'll add a small Grafana panel on the quota dashboard that shows `duplicate-reserve` spikes and `charged_vs_reserved` ratio per org.

jess-prodeng: action items:
- anna: rollback routing header change (hotfix) (ETA 30m)
- mike: add billing guard (PR) (ETA EOD)
- kevin: add telemetry panels + alert (ETA 2d)
- jess: reservation dedupe design + implement (ETA 1w)

anna.dev: thanks. pinging @kevin-telemetry if you see any obvious edgecases where toolcalls should still be counted as completion (eg tools that generate content back to model)

kevin-telemetry: noted. will add a small test harness to simulate toolcall forks and verify charged token breakdowns.

mike.platform: also consider showing in Console billing UI a breakdown: reserved, charged, released so customers can debug when they see spikes. That'll reduce support tickets.

anna.dev: good call. I'll file a UX ticket for console billing breakdown.

sre-bot: rollback complete, 2025-11-02T09:43:10Z, risk low.

anna.dev: rolling hotfix to keep idempotency headers across routing now. will update thread when PR merges. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: INC-20251102-01 set to monitoring until next 24h

mike.platform: thanks everyone. if anyone sees org-42 still mischarged after fixes, DM me immediately so we can refund and reconcile.

anna.dev: will follow up with postmortem after telemetry stabilizes.
